summary: VNET Group filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited first quarter 2026 earnings press release. The release reports financial results, including a 19.8% year-over-year revenue increase to RMB2.69 billion and a 30.6% adjusted EBITDA rise. It mentions strategic investor CATL and REIT listings as capital recycling, but no specific acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation transaction terms are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a trigger for a special-situations category.
